## Story Goal

Make Arabic a first-class experience across the whole product and give the workspace a single, branded visual language.

1. A signed-in user switches between **Arabic** and **English** from the top bar; the entire UI re-renders **without a page reload**, and the choice **persists per user** (server-side on the user record, not only in `localStorage`).
2. The document direction flips to `rtl` for Arabic and `ltr` for English; layout is built with **logical CSS properties** (`margin-inline-start`, `padding-inline-end`, `inset-inline-*`, `text-align: start`) so that icons, tables, form alignment and horizontal scroll behave correctly in both directions.
3. Dates, times, numbers and durations are formatted with `Intl` APIs using the active locale, and every instant returned by the API (ISO-8601 UTC) is rendered in the correct display time zone.
4. **No user-facing string is hardcoded in a component.** All copy comes from `frontend/src/i18n/en.json` and `frontend/src/i18n/ar.json`, enforced by a lint-style test.
5. Bilingual API fields (the `{ en, ar }` shape described by `frontend/src/api/generated/model/bilingualString.ts`) render in the active locale with the documented fallback.
6. Organisation logo and primary colours apply across the workspace UI, the customer portal surfaces and the Blade email/report templates under `resources/views/`.
7. The visual baseline (colour tokens, type scale, spacing, component patterns) is taken from `docs/ui/customer-portal-reference.html` and applied to **all** screens, not just the portal.

**Out of scope:** building new feature screens (tickets, customers, reporting pages) — this story delivers the presentation primitives plus the retrofit of the screens that already exist under `frontend/src/pages/` and `frontend/src/shell/`. Charting libraries are not introduced here; only the RTL rules that future charts must follow are documented.

## Product rules (from story)

| Area | Current behaviour | New behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Language switching | Locale is fixed/implicit at load time in `frontend/src/i18n/LocaleProvider.tsx`. | Runtime switch from the top bar, **no reload**, persisted to the user record via the API and rehydrated on next sign-in. |
| Direction | Layout assumes LTR. | `dir` attribute driven by the active locale; all spacing/alignment uses logical CSS properties. |
| Formatting | Raw ISO strings / raw numbers rendered. | Locale-aware `Intl` formatters for date, time, number, currency and duration; every instant rendered in the resolved display zone. |
| Copy | Strings inline in components. | Every string resolved through a translation key; enforced by test. |
| Bilingual API fields | Rendered ad hoc. | Rendered via a single helper implementing the fallback documented in `docs/contracts/localization.md`. |
| Branding | Default Tailwind palette. | Organisation logo + primary colours from a branding source, applied to workspace, portal and Blade templates. |
| Visual language | Ad hoc per screen. | Tokens and component patterns extracted from `docs/ui/customer-portal-reference.html`. |

## Frontend Tasks

### 1 — Design tokens extracted from the reference

**File: `frontend/src/index.css`**

Declare the token layer as CSS custom properties on `:root`, sourced verbatim from the `<style>` block of `docs/ui/customer-portal-reference.html` (colours, surface/border colours, radii, shadows, font family stack, type scale, spacing steps). Group them:

```css
:root {
  /* colour */
  --color-primary: /* from reference */;
  --color-primary-foreground: /* … */;
  --color-surface: /* … */;
  --color-border: /* … */;
  --color-muted-foreground: /* … */;
  /* radius / shadow / typography / spacing … */
}
```

Add a **branding override block** immediately after, so runtime branding can re-assign a small, explicit subset:

```css
:root[data-branded="true"] {
  /* values injected at runtime by the branding provider */
}
```

**Do not** hardcode hex values anywhere outside this file.

**File: `frontend/tailwind.config.js`**

Map the Tailwind theme onto the CSS variables (`theme.extend.colors.primary = 'var(--color-primary)'`, etc.) so utility classes and raw CSS share one source of truth. Extend `theme.extend.fontFamily` with an Arabic-capable stack so Arabic text does not fall back to a Latin-first font.

Enable logical-property utilities: prefer Tailwind's `ms-*`, `me-*`, `ps-*`, `pe-*`, `start-*`, `end-*`, `text-start`, `text-end` classes over `ml-*`, `mr-*`, `pl-*`, `pr-*`, `left-*`, `right-*`, `text-left`, `text-right`.

### 2 — Locale layer: runtime switching + persistence

**File: `frontend/src/i18n/index.ts`**

Export the supported locale union and the message catalogues:

```ts
export const SUPPORTED_LOCALES = ['en', 'ar'] as const;
export type Locale = (typeof SUPPORTED_LOCALES)[number];
export const DEFAULT_LOCALE: Locale = 'en';
export const LOCALE_DIRECTION: Record<Locale, 'ltr' | 'rtl'> = { en: 'ltr', ar: 'rtl' };
```

**File: `frontend/src/i18n/LocaleProvider.tsx`**

Extend the existing provider (keep its current exported names so call sites do not break — confirm them by reading the file first) to:

- Hold `locale` in React state, initialised from, in order: (a) the authenticated user's stored locale from `frontend/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx`, (b) `localStorage`, (c) `navigator.language` when it resolves to a supported locale, (d) `DEFAULT_LOCALE`.
- Expose a `setLocale(next: Locale)` that: updates state (re-render, **no reload**), writes `localStorage`, sets `document.documentElement.lang` and `document.documentElement.dir` from `LOCALE_DIRECTION`, and fires the persistence mutation (Task 3).
- Expose a translation function `t(key: string, vars?: Record<string, string | number>)` doing a flat-key lookup against the active catalogue with `{placeholder}` interpolation. On a **missing key**: return the key itself and `console.warn` in dev; **never** render `undefined`.

**Create file: `frontend/src/i18n/useTranslation.ts`** — thin hook re-exporting `{ t, locale, direction, setLocale }` from the provider context, so components never import the context object directly.

**Files: `frontend/src/i18n/en.json`, `frontend/src/i18n/ar.json`**

Restructure into namespaced flat keys and keep the two files **key-identical**:

```json
{
  "common.save": "Save",
  "common.cancel": "Cancel",
  "shell.nav.dashboard": "Dashboard",
  "state.empty.title": "Nothing here yet",
  "auth.login.title": "Sign in"

```

Every key added to `en.json` must be added to `ar.json` in the same commit with real Arabic copy — not the English string.

| Replace | With |
|---|---|
| `ml-*` / `mr-*` | `ms-*` / `me-*` |
| `pl-*` / `pr-*` | `ps-*` / `pe-*` |
| `left-*` / `right-*` | `start-*` / `end-*` |

**Directional icons** (chevrons, back/forward arrows, "next page") must mirror. ### 5 — Locale-aware formatting

**Create file: `frontend/src/i18n/format.ts`**

Pure functions built on `Intl`, each taking the active locale explicitly so they are testable without React:

```ts
export function formatDate(iso: string, locale: Locale, timeZone: string): string;
export function formatDateTime(iso: string, locale: Locale, timeZone: string): string;
export function formatTime(iso: string, locale: Locale, timeZone: string): string;
export function formatNumber(value: number, locale: Locale, options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions): string;
export function formatDuration(seconds: number, locale: Locale): string;
export function formatRelative(iso: string, locale: Locale, now?: Date): string;
```

Rules:
- The API returns instants as **ISO-8601 UTC strings**. Every formatter takes an explicit `timeZone` and passes it to `Intl.DateTimeFormat`; **never** rely on the browser default implicitly — resolve it once (organisation/user zone if the API supplies one, else `Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone`) and pass it down.
- `formatDuration` builds from `Intl.NumberFormat` unit formatting (or `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat` for relative), producing e.g. "2h 15m" / "٢ س ١٥ د" — never a hand-concatenated English string.
- **Digits:** decide once and document — use `latn` numbering system for both locales (`new Intl.NumberFormat('ar', { numberingSystem: 'latn' })`) so ticket references, IDs and SLA counters stay scannable. Encode this as a shared options constant in `format.ts` so it cannot drift per call site.
- Cache `Intl.*Format` instances in a module-level `Map` keyed by `locale + options` — constructing them per render is a measurable cost in tables.

**Create file: `frontend/src/i18n/useFormat.ts`** — hook binding the formatters to the active locale and resolved time zone so components call `const { formatDateTime } = useFormat()`.

**Create file: `frontend/src/i18n/bilingual.ts`**

```ts
import type { BilingualString } from '../api/generated/model/bilingualString';
import type { Locale } from './index';

export function resolveBilingual(
  value: BilingualString | null | undefined,
  locale: Locale,
): string;
```

Implement **exactly** the fallback documented in `docs/contracts/localization.md` (read it — do not guess): active locale value if non-empty, otherwise the other locale's value, otherwise an empty string. Never render the literal `"[object Object]"` or the JSON blob.

Add a `<BilingualText value={…} />` component in the same folder so lists and tables have a one-import call site.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Locale persistence fails (network/403).** The UI has already flipped optimistically. Revert to the previous locale, keep the `localStorage` value unchanged, and surface a non-blocking error. Enforced in the `setLocale` handler in `frontend/src/i18n/LocaleProvider.tsx`.
- **Missing translation key.** `t()` returns the key string and warns in dev. It must **never** render `undefined`, `null`, or throw — a missing key must not blank a screen. Covered by the parity test (Test Plan §1).
- **Key present in `en.json` but missing in `ar.json` (or vice versa).** Caught by the catalogue-parity unit test, which fails the build. This is the primary regression guard against Arabic silently degrading to English.
- **Bilingual field with one side empty or the whole object null.** `resolveBilingual` returns the fallback side, then `''`. Never `"[object Object]"`. Verified against `docs/contracts/localization.md`.
- **Invalid or unsupported locale in `localStorage` / user record** (e.g. `fr`, or a stale value). Coerce to `DEFAULT_LOCALE` in the provider initialiser; never pass an unvalidated string to `Intl.*Format`, which throws `RangeError` on malformed tags.
- **Invalid time zone string from the API.** `Intl.DateTimeFormat` throws `RangeError` for an unknown IANA zone. `format.ts` must catch this once at resolution time and fall back to the browser-resolved zone rather than crashing every cell in a table.
- **Unparseable / null instant.** Formatters receiving `null`, `''`, or a non-ISO string must return an em dash placeholder, not `Invalid Date`.
- **RTL horizontal scroll.** Browsers historically disagree on the sign of `scrollLeft` in RTL. Any code reading or setting `scrollLeft` must normalise; prefer `scrollBy`/`scrollIntoView` over raw offsets.
- **Icon over-mirroring.** A global `rtl:-scale-x-100` would mirror logos, clocks and user avatars. Mirroring must be opt-in per directional icon — this is the single most common RTL defect in this codebase's future.
- **Mixed-direction content:** an Arabic UI showing an English customer name, an email address, a ticket reference, or a URL. Wrap such values with `dir="auto"` (or `unicode-bidi: plaintext`) so punctuation does not jump to the wrong side. Ticket references and identifiers must stay LTR inside Arabic sentences.
- **Direction flip without reload.** Some third-party or CSS-transition-based components latch their direction at mount. Any component that misbehaves must be keyed on `locale` so React remounts it; do **not** solve this by reloading the page — that violates the acceptance criterion.
- **Branding colour with poor contrast.** A pale brand primary with white foreground fails WCAG AA. `BrandingProvider` computes the foreground; if contrast cannot be met, fall back to the default primary and log.
- **Missing/broken logo URL.** Render the wordmark fallback via the image `onError` handler; a broken image icon in the top bar is a visible defect.
- **Email clients and CSS variables.** Resolved server-side (Backend §B4) — a `var()` in an email template renders as no colour at all in Outlook.
- **Uncertainty to resolve during execution:** the exact locale request header name and the exact bilingual fallback order are defined by `app/Http/Middleware/NegotiateLocale.php`, `app/Support/I18n/LocaleResolver.php` and `docs/contracts/localization.md`. Read those three before writing the mutator and `bilingual.ts`; do not assume `Accept-Language`.
- **Uncertainty to resolve during execution:** whether a profile-update endpoint already exists. Grep `routes/api.php` for the `auth/me` group before adding Backend §B2 — a duplicate route is worse than a reused one.

1. **Unit — catalogue parity.** Create `frontend/src/i18n/__tests__/catalogue-parity.test.ts`. Assert `Object.keys(en).sort()` deep-equals `Object.keys(ar).sort()`, that no value is an empty string, and that no `ar.json` value is byte-identical to its `en.json` counterpart except for an explicit allow-list (product names, acronyms). Follow the structure of `frontend/src/__tests__/no-role-names.test.ts`.
2. **Unit — no hardcoded user-facing strings.** Create `frontend/src/__tests__/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`, modelled directly on `frontend/src/__tests__/no-role-names.test.ts` (which already walks the source tree). Scan `frontend/src/{pages,shell,auth,branding}/**/*.tsx` for JSX text nodes and string literals passed to `title`/`label`/`placeholder`/`aria-label` props that are not translation-key lookups. Allow-list `frontend/src/api/generated/**` and `frontend/src/i18n/*.json`. Mirror the exclusion style of `tests/Unit/Support/NoHardcodedUserFacingStringsTest.php`.
3. **Unit — formatters.** Create `frontend/src/i18n/__tests__/format.test.ts`. Cover: `formatDateTime` for the same UTC instant in `en`/`ar` and in two different time zones producing different wall-clock output; `formatNumber` producing Latin digits in Arabic; `formatDuration` for `0`, sub-minute, multi-hour and multi-day values; every formatter returning the placeholder for `null`/`''`/`'not-a-date'`; an unknown time zone falling back instead of throwing.
4. **Unit — bilingual resolution.** Create `frontend/src/i18n/__tests__/bilingual.test.ts`. Cases: both sides present (active locale wins), active side empty string, active side `null`, whole value `null`/`undefined`, both sides empty. Assert against the fallback documented in `docs/contracts/localization.md`.
5. **Unit — direction mapping.** Create `frontend/src/i18n/__tests__/direction.test.ts`. Render the provider, switch locale to `ar`, assert `document.documentElement.dir === 'rtl'` and `lang === 'ar'`; switch back and assert `ltr`/`en`. Assert **no** navigation/reload occurs (spy on `location.assign`/`reload`).
6. **Unit — locale switch persistence.** Create `frontend/src/i18n/__tests__/locale-switch.test.tsx`. Mock the generated persistence mutation; assert it is called with the new locale on switch, and that a rejected mutation reverts the rendered locale.
7. **Unit — branding.** Create `frontend/src/branding/__tests__/branding.test.tsx`. Assert: configured primary sets the CSS custom property and `data-branded="true"`; absent branding leaves the defaults intact; a broken logo URL renders the wordmark fallback.
8. **Feature (backend) — locale persistence.** Add `tests/Feature/Security/UserLocalePreferenceTest.php` (follow `tests/Feature/Security/AuthMeTest.php` for setup and envelope assertions). Cover: a valid locale is stored and returned by `/auth/me`; an unsupported locale is rejected with the standard validation envelope; an unauthenticated call is rejected; no attribute other than `locale` is mutated.
9. **Contract regression.** Run the existing `tests/Feature/Api/ContractFreezeTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Api/OpenApiCoverageTest.php` and `tests/Feature/Api/ResponseEnvelopeTest.php` unchanged; any new endpoint must be reflected in `docs/api/openapi.yaml` so these stay green.
10. **Backend guards.** Run `tests/Unit/Support/NoHardcodedUserFacingStringsTest.php` and `tests/Unit/Support/MassAssignmentAuditTest.php` — both are directly in the blast radius of Backend §B1–B3.
11. **Manual RTL review (blocking).** Every screen currently implemented under `frontend/src/pages/` plus the shell chrome must be walked through in Arabic before acceptance. Record the checklist in the PR description: sidebar side, icon direction, table alignment, form label alignment, horizontal scroll, modal/dropdown anchoring, and the login and two-factor screens. **An RTL defect blocks the story.**

## Migration / Rollback

- The only schema change is Backend §B3 (nullable branding columns on `auth_settings`). It is additive and nullable; rolling the migration back leaves the application fully functional because `BrandingProvider` falls back to the reference-design defaults.
- **Half-applied state:** if the frontend ships expecting branding fields that the migration has not created, the bootstrap payload simply omits them and the provider uses defaults — no crash. Ensure `BrandingProvider` treats every branding field as **optional**, so ordering of deploys does not matter.
- Backend §B1/§B2 are additive to the API surface. Rolling back the frontend leaves an unused endpoint; rolling back the backend leaves the switcher persisting to a 404 — which the optimistic-revert path in §3 already handles gracefully by reverting and showing an error. The locale still works for the session via `localStorage`.
- No data backfill is needed: the `users.locale` column already exists and existing rows fall back to the tenant default from `auth_settings`.

1. **Frontend type-check and lint:** from `frontend/`, run `npm run lint` and `npx tsc --noEmit` (config: `frontend/tsconfig.json`, `frontend/eslint.config.js`). Zero errors.
2. **Frontend tests:** from `frontend/`, run `npm test` (Vitest; config `frontend/vitest.config.ts`). All new tests in `frontend/src/i18n/__tests__/`, `frontend/src/branding/__tests__/` and `frontend/src/__tests__/` pass.
3. **Frontend runs:** from `frontend/`, run `npm run dev`, sign in, and toggle the language switcher. Confirm in DevTools that `<html dir>` flips between `ltr` and `rtl`, that **no navigation entry is added** (no reload), and that a hard refresh restores the persisted locale.
4. **Frontend builds:** from `frontend/`, run `npm run build`. The production bundle must build clean.
5. **API client regeneration (only if Backend §B2 added an endpoint):** from `frontend/`, run the orval command configured in `frontend/orval.config.ts`. Commit the regenerated files under `frontend/src/api/generated/` without manual edits.
6. **Backend static analysis:** from the repo root, run `vendor/bin/phpstan analyse` (config `phpstan.neon`). Clean.
7. **Backend tests:** from the repo root, run `php artisan test --filter=Locale` then the full `php artisan test`. All green, including the contract-freeze suite.
8. **Regression:** from the repo root, run `php artisan test --testsuite=Feature` and confirm `tests/Feature/Api/ContractFreezeTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Api/OpenApiCoverageTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Security/AuthMeTest.php` and `tests/Unit/Support/NoHardcodedUserFacingStringsTest.php` all pass.
9. **Email branding:** render `resources/views/mail/security/user-invited.blade.php` (via `php artisan tinker` or the invitation flow with `MAIL_MAILER=log`) with an Arabic recipient locale and confirm `dir="rtl"`, the logo, and a literal resolved colour value (no `var(...)`) in the output HTML.
10. **Manual Arabic review:** walk every implemented screen in Arabic per Test Plan §11 and attach the checklist to the PR.

## Done Criteria

- [ ] Language switches at runtime from the top bar with **no page reload**, and the choice persists per user across sessions and devices (stored server-side on the user record).
- [ ] `document.documentElement.dir` and `lang` track the active locale; all shell and page components use logical CSS properties; directional icons mirror and non-directional icons do not.
- [ ] Tables, form alignment and horizontal scroll behave correctly in Arabic; mixed-direction values (emails, references, URLs) render with `dir="auto"`.
- [ ] Dates, times, numbers and durations are formatted through `frontend/src/i18n/format.ts` using `Intl`, with an explicit time zone for every instant.
- [ ] No user-facing string remains inline in any component under `frontend/src/{pages,shell,auth,branding}`; the guard test in `frontend/src/__tests__/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` passes.
- [ ] `en.json` and `ar.json` have identical key sets with real Arabic copy; the parity test passes.
- [ ] Bilingual API fields render via `resolveBilingual` with the fallback documented in `docs/contracts/localization.md`.
- [ ] Organisation logo and primary colours apply to the workspace shell, portal surfaces and the Blade templates in `resources/views/`, with a safe default when branding is unset.
- [ ] Colour tokens, type scale and component patterns in `frontend/src/index.css` and `frontend/tailwind.config.js` derive from `docs/ui/customer-portal-reference.html`; no ad hoc hex values outside the token file.
- [ ] `docs/api/openapi.yaml` updated for any new/changed endpoint and the contract-freeze suite passes.
- [ ] Every implemented screen has been reviewed in Arabic and the review checklist is recorded on the PR; **no open RTL defect**.
